scope: All tracks and branches on39 nominated critical nets:4USB,18SD,11speaker/microphoneI2S,6EPD SPI. This is nominal2D projection, not impedance/return-inductance/eye/timing/EMI certification. Actual saved inner GND fill used; no refill or CAD edit. Pad-only connections with zero track length are named in summary but are not track-projection-certified.
antipad_algorithm_evidence: antipad-bound-research.md: KiCad10.0.8 ExtraFillMargin andERROR_OUTSIDE/arc segment rounding; no arbitrary0.01mm allowance.
self_antipad_policy: Own-net nativeERROR_OUTSIDE clearance polygons include the actual ExtraFillMargin and board maximum approximation error; circular pads/vias use a strictly circumscribed envelope of native vertex radii. This is explained separately, not called plane copper. Entire merged void is never exempted. Physical F/B track transitions through these nodes must meet the stated nearbyGND access target; PTH terminals with only one outer track layer are listed separately.
